field.description: `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `language`, `status`, `created_at`, `segment`, `email.sent`, `email.delivered`, `email.opened`, `email.clicked`, `email.bounced`, `email.complained`, or `property.<key>` for a property you added.

operator.description: Text fields take `is`, `is_not`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `is_set` and `is_not_set`. Numbers take `equals`, `not_equals`, `greater_than` and `less_than`. Dates take `within`, `not_within`, `before` and `after`. `segment` takes `in` and `not_in`. Email activity takes `within`, `not_within`, `at_least` and `never`.

value.description: Text up to 500 characters, a number or a boolean. A date window is a date or a number of days such as `30d`. `at_least` takes `{ "count": 2, "days": 30 }`, with a count up to 1,000 and up to 400 days. A `segment` rule takes the id of a static segment.

scheduled_at.description: An ISO 8601 time to start sending.

from.description: Sender on a verified domain, such as `Acme <hello@acme.dev>`, 3 to 320 characters. Required unless the template sets one.

to.description: One address or a list. An address can carry a name, such as `Jane <jane@example.com>`, up to 640 characters each. At most 50 recipients across `to`, `cc` and `bcc`. Repeated addresses are sent once.

cc.description: Carbon copy recipients. One address or a list. An address can carry a name, such as `Jane <jane@example.com>`, up to 640 characters each.

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipients. One address or a list. An address can carry a name, such as `Jane <jane@example.com>`, up to 640 characters each.

reply_to.description: Addresses that replies go to. One address or a list. An address can carry a name, such as `Jane <jane@example.com>`, up to 640 characters each. Defaults to the template’s reply-to.

subject.description: Email subject, 1 to 998 characters, without line breaks. Required unless the template sets one.

html.description: HTML body. Send `html`, `text` or both, unless the template has content.

oneOf.description: Send with a template. Its from, reply-to, subject and content fill the fields you leave out. The template content is used only when you send neither `html` nor `text`.

headers.description: Custom headers, up to 50, each with a string value and no line breaks. Allowed names are `In-Reply-To`, `References`, `List-Unsubscribe`, `List-Unsubscribe-Post` and most `X-` headers. A few `X-` names are reserved.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags, stored with the email and passed to webhooks. Use each name once. `email_id`, `workspace_id` and `campaign_id` are reserved.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, such as `2026-10-20T09:00:00Z`, in the future and up to 30 days ahead. Leave it out to send now.

attachments.description: Up to 20 files, 30 MB in total. The whole request can be up to 45 MB.

variables.description: Values for the template variables, such as `{ "first_name": "Ada" }`. They fill the subject, preheader and content.

id.description: The topic id. The topic must exist.

description.description: Shown on the preference page, up to 500 characters.

default_subscribed.description: Whether a new contact is subscribed to the topic until they choose.

oneOf.description: `public` shows the topic on the preference page. `private` hides it.

double_opt_in.description: Whether a sign-up through the form must confirm by email first.

form_enabled.description: Whether the hosted sign-up form is on. It needs a sender first.

sender_name.description: The from name for confirmation emails, up to 100 characters.

sender_email.description: The from address for confirmation emails. It must be on a verified domain.

redirect_url.description: An `https://` page to show after someone signs up.

contact_id.description: The contact the event belongs to.

topics.description: Topic choices to save, up to 100. Topics you leave out keep their choice.

first_name.description: First name, up to 200 characters. Send `null` to clear it.

last_name.description: Last name, up to 200 characters. Send `null` to clear it.

language.description: A language code, such as `en` or `pt-BR`.

notes.description: Private notes, up to 5,000 characters. Send `null` to clear them.

properties.description: Values for properties you added in Settings, keyed by the property key. Each value must match the property type: text up to 2,000 characters, a number, `true` or `false`, a date, or one of a choice property’s options. `null` clears a value. The values merge with the ones the contact has.

subscribed.description: `true` subscribes the contact. `false` unsubscribes the contact from all email.

segment_ids.description: The static segments the contact belongs to, up to 50. The contact joins the ones in the list and leaves the static segments that are not in it. Leave it out to keep the segments as they are.

description.description: A description. Send `null` to clear it.

oneOf.description: New rules for a dynamic segment. They replace the old ones.

size.description: The file size in bytes, up to 5 MB.

event_id.description: The event id, also in the payload.

endpoint_id.description: The webhook the event went to.

email_id.description: The email the event is about.

status.description: The HTTP status your endpoint answered.

created_at.description: When the event was first sent.

next_attempt_at.description: When it is tried again, if it failed.

RequestId.description: The id of this request. Send it to support

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window

RateLimitPolicy.description: The limit and the window in seconds, like 10;w=1

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before a retry. Sent with 429 and with 409 concurrent_idempotent_requests

IdempotentReplayed.description: Present when the response is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key

api_key.description: An API key as a bearer token. Each route lists the scopes it needs: `sending` works with every key, `full` needs a Full key, and `workspace` needs a key that is not limited to one domain.
